files.finding: Runner server session establishment precedes the Listening for Jobs state and message wait loop; local process/service existence therefore does not prove a connected listening session.

CreateSessionAsync loads settings and credentials, connects to GitHub, constructs the agent session and attempts server-side session creation; this is a distinct boundary from local service/process liveness.
The stock Linux systemd unit invokes runsvc.sh and has no unconditional Restart= policy in the pinned source.
The service wrapper invokes RunnerService.js and propagates its exit code.
The stock wrapper has bounded/conditional retry behavior for selected runner exit codes; service configuration and listener/server-session health remain distinct observations.

external_primary_findings.source: GitHub Docs — Routing precedence for self-hosted runners
external_primary_findings.finding: A matching self-hosted runner must be online and idle before GitHub assigns a queued job. Assignment, pickup, and execution are separate transitions.

external_primary_findings.source: GitHub Docs — Using labels with self-hosted runners
external_primary_findings.finding: Runner labels are case-insensitive; Linux/X64 capitalization is not a viable explanation for the observed zero-step job.

external_primary_findings.source: GitHub Docs — Monitoring and troubleshooting self-hosted runners
external_primary_findings.finding: Offline can mean host offline, runner application not running, or inability to communicate with GitHub; direct service/process/connectivity evidence is needed to separate these causes.
Runner update age is part of scheduling eligibility; a sufficiently stale self-hosted runner can stop receiving queued jobs and therefore version/update state is a transport-health observation.

architecture_mapping.name: RuntimeTransportEvidence
architecture_mapping.purpose: Separate target-runtime transport/admission evidence from Frankenstein product semantics so scheduler or runner failures cannot mint or destroy semantic/runtime credit.

stages.positive_evidence: Exact source/artifact/workflow subject digest and runtime request identity are fixed.
stages.must_not_infer: No host reachability, runner health, execution or target behavior.

stages.positive_evidence: Read-only local runner configuration identifies intended repository/organization registration target and local labels where available.
stages.must_not_infer: Configured does not mean remotely registered, online, connected or eligible.

stages.positive_evidence: Authenticated GitHub runner roster shows the intended runner identity/status/labels, when that API surface is available.
stages.must_not_infer: API denial/unavailability is UNKNOWN, never runner offline.

stages.positive_evidence: Owner-host systemd/service observation reports active service state at a bound timestamp.
stages.must_not_infer: Service active does not prove listener process/server session connectivity.

stages.positive_evidence: Bound process observation shows runner listener/wrapper process identity, PID and start time.
stages.must_not_infer: Listener process existence does not prove GitHub server session creation or routing eligibility.

stages.positive_evidence: Runner diagnostics/logs or equivalent direct observation show successful GitHub connection/session and Listening for Jobs state.
stages.must_not_infer: Connected listener does not prove labels/group/repository/version eligibility for the particular job.

stages.positive_evidence: Required labels, repository/group access and supported runner version are positively matched for the exact job route.
stages.must_not_infer: Eligibility does not prove GitHub actually assigned this job to this runner. Broad self-hosted routing can remain placement-ambiguous when multiple runners qualify.

stages.positive_evidence: Exact GitHub job record binds a nonzero runner_id/name/group to the runtime request.
stages.must_not_infer: Assignment does not prove workflow step startup or target command execution.

stages.positive_evidence: Exact job record contains workflow step start/execution evidence on the assigned runner.
stages.must_not_infer: A setup or preliminary step does not prove exact WP1207 hostile-twin executor invocation.

stages.positive_evidence: Target-host step positively proves the expected direct capability/surface used for the runtime test, bound to the job and subject.
stages.must_not_infer: Capability presence does not prove hostile-twin semantics or completion.

stages.positive_evidence: Exact bound runtime subject executes and yields a validated target-host receipt with provenance and result scope.
stages.must_not_infer: A bounded WP1207 receipt does not mint whole-system, physical GRID10, GWT, J-Space, effect or completion credit beyond its declared scope.

current_subject_classification.negative_observation: The historical job reached neither T7_JOB_ASSIGNED nor T8_STEP_EXECUTION_STARTED.
current_subject_classification.why_unknown: No fresh direct owner-host service/listener/session/version observation is available in this Trigger6 evidence set, and remote runner roster visibility is not authoritative when unavailable.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Runner service/listener was down or stopped.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Fresh owner-host service + process + journal observation around a new bound probe.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Runner process was live but GitHub session/connectivity failed.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Runner diagnostic logs/connectivity check showing successful session and Listening for Jobs.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Runner was connected but not eligible for the job route.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Positive label plus repository/group eligibility observation for the exact runner/job pair.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Runner software was too stale to receive jobs.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Exact installed runner version and update-age check against current GitHub support window.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Broad self-hosted routing selected or could select the wrong runner.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Exact runner_id assignment evidence or a deliberately restricted runner label/group chosen after observing the actual roster.

counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: WP1207 hostile-twin executor failed on the owner host.
counterhypotheses_and_falsifiers.falsifier: Only an assigned, step-executed, exact-subject target receipt can test this hypothesis; the zero-step historical job cannot.

recommended_sequence: Read-only owner-host service status, listener PID/start time, runner diagnostics, registration target, labels/group if locally visible, and exact runner version.
Use authenticated remote runner roster/status only when available; map access denial to UNKNOWN rather than offline.
Resolve T3-T6 transport health before dispatching another semantic WP1207 runtime probe.
If transport is positively healthy, retry exactly one source-bound WP1207 subject and record T7 through T10 as separately evidenced transitions.
If multiple self-hosted runners are eligible, bind routing to an exact intended runner using an observed label/group strategy before claiming target-host evidence.
Do not add an unconditional Restart= policy solely from source archaeology; first observe the actual failure mode and preserve owner-authorized VPS constraints.
integration_advisory_for_trigger4.candidate_artifact: A small append-only RuntimeTransportEvidence receipt/gate owned by the build/runtime evidence layer, not by canonical product state.

next_exact_action: Trigger4 should perform one fresh read-only owner-host runner lifecycle/connection/version inspection. If and only if the intended runner is positively connected and eligible, execute one exact-source WP1207 retry and capture runner assignment, step start, direct target capability and target receipt as separate evidence stages.
